First, understand that stationary points occur where the derivative f '(x) equals zero. Start by differentiating f(x) to get f '(x). Set f '(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are candidates for stationary points. Next, substitute them back into f(x) to get the corresponding y-values. Finally, use the second derivative test or analyze the behavior of f '(x) to determine whether each point is a maximum, minimum, or inflection point.
